imageBoundsConvention: [west, south, east, north], pixel outer edges. Images are north-up.

propertyOrthophoto.provider: New York State ITS Geospatial Services, NY Statewide Digital Orthoimagery Program, Sullivan County, 2025
propertyOrthophoto.nativeCRS: EPSG:6537 (NAD83(2011) / New York East, US survey feet)
propertyOrthophoto.export: Native bands 1–3 reprojected with cubic resampling for these crops. The model uses ground photographs and estimated heights below canopy cover.

countyRoad.measurement: Model feet y = −34.2221 − 0.01804675 x fits the centerline across the frontage. Traveled width 19.6 ft is an estimate.

countyParcel.use: Tax mapping controls the approximate lot extent. It is not a boundary survey.

neighborhoodSatellite.provider: Copernicus Sentinel-2C MSI, Level-2A bottom-of-atmosphere reflectance; Element 84 Earth Search and Microsoft Planetary Computer

radiometry.earthSearchConversion: B04 and B08 reflectance = COG DN / 10000. The COG has already removed the baseline offset.
radiometry.method: Nearest sampling of the same 90-by-90 map grid from both vendors. Every corresponding red and near infrared cell in the independent copy is exactly 1000 DN higher. The independent SAFE product metadata lists BOA_ADD_OFFSET −1000 and BOA_QUANTIFICATION_VALUE 10000.

Neighborhood satellite.jpg.source: Native three-band true-color image (TCI), resampled to the 90-by-90 neighborhood grid using nearest neighbors; no local color stretching.

Woodland context/Summer vegetation.json.source: NDVI = (B08 − B04)/(B08 + B04). Only positive jointly valid observations classified by the nearest 20 m SCL cell as vegetation, bare ground, water or unclassified (4, 5, 6 or 7) are retained.
Woodland context/Summer vegetation.json.use: Thins existing off-parcel understory candidates. Mixed 10 m pixels do not resolve individual trees or plants.

woodlandBackdrop.detail: Existing subdued leaf-off NYS image across the wider background. LiDAR locates approximate crown peaks; details in lidar-provenance.json.
